title: Diviner
description:
[h1]Diviner[/h1]
[b]A complete Slay the Spire 2 character mod about reading the future, bargaining with fate, and surviving the consequences.[/b]

[h2]English[/h2]
The Diviner begins each run with a [b]Crystal Ball[/b] and a Destiny value from 0 to 5. Destiny changes how the character's cards behave and reshapes parts of the run.

[b]Core mechanics[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Destiny[/b] moves between bad and good omens. High Destiny grants safer and rarer opportunities; low Destiny invites danger.
[*][b]Divinate[/b] records real information about the future run, including bosses, relic queues, shops, events, and Ancient rewards. Open the Crystal Ball ledger to review these predictions.
[*][b]Foretell[/b] queues effects for the start of your next turn, rewarding careful sequencing and preparation.
[*]At Destiny 0, [b]Doomed[/b] begins a lethal countdown that must be escaped. At Destiny 5, [b]Revelation[/b] unlocks powerful card effects.
[*][b]Fortune[/b] and [b]Misfortune[/b] cards turn favorable and unfavorable omens into immediate tactical resources.
[/list]

Expect a full character card pool, custom relics and potions, Ancient cards and relic interactions, custom combat and character artwork, a dedicated Destiny ledger, and extensive card-search and relic-forecast tools. The character supports both English and Simplified Chinese.

[b]Requirement:[/b] BaseLib 3.3.2 or newer. Subscribe to the required item listed by Steam Workshop.

[h2]简体中文[/h2]
占卜师是一名围绕预知未来、操纵命运以及承担代价构筑的完整角色。每局游戏以[b]水晶球[/b]和 0 至 5 点[b]命运[/b]开始。命运不仅改变卡牌效果，也会影响整局冒险中的部分遭遇与奖励。

[b]核心机制[/b]
[list]
[*][b]命运[/b]在凶兆与吉兆之间变化。高命运带来更安全、更稀有的机会；低命运则会引来危险。
[*][b]占卜[/b]会记录本局游戏真实的未来信息，包括首领、遗物序列、商店、事件与先古奖励。你可以打开水晶球账册随时查看。
[*][b]预言[/b]会将效果排入队列，并在你的下个回合开始时结算，鼓励提前规划出牌顺序。
[*]命运为 0 时进入[b]劫兆[/b]，开始致命的命运倒计时；命运为 5 时进入[b]启示[/b]，解锁强力卡牌效果。
[*][b]福运[/b]与[b]噩运[/b]牌会将吉凶征兆转化为即时的战斗资源与风险。
[/list]

本模组包含完整角色卡池、自定义遗物与药水、先古卡牌和遗物互动、专属战斗及角色美术、命运账册，以及多种卡牌检索和遗物预知机制。完整支持英文与简体中文。

[b]前置需求：[/b]BaseLib 3.3.2 或更高版本。请订阅 Steam 创意工坊列出的必需物品。

[h2]AI-generated content disclosure / AI 生成内容声明[/h2]
All original visual assets made for Diviner were generated with AI-assisted image tools, then selected, cropped, cleaned, resized, background-processed, and integrated by the mod author. No claim is made that these images were hand-painted. Game code, mechanics, balance, localization integration, asset processing, and implementation were assembled and maintained for this mod.

占卜师的原创视觉素材均使用 AI 辅助图像工具生成，并由模组作者进行筛选、裁剪、清理、缩放、背景处理与游戏内适配。本模组不宣称这些图像为纯手绘作品。模组的程序、机制、平衡、本地化整合、素材处理与实现由作者制作并维护。
changeNote:
[h2]English - Gameplay and stability update[/h2]
[list]
[*]Reworked Destiny at 0: further Destiny loss now removes Countdown of Destiny instead.
[*]Reworked Fixed Point into a 1-cost Skill: Destiny cannot change and your hand is retained for the turn. The upgrade costs 0.
[*]Applied the latest card balance pass, including Divulge, Cursed Prediction, Thread Cut+, Doomscript+, Narrow Escape, Star Needle, Inevitability, Read Ahead, Omen of Pestilence, Predestined Path, Ledger of Signs, Apocalypse, Unavoidable End, Perfect Forecast, Omen of Transcendence, Many Futures, and Omen of Perishment interactions.
[*]Relic Banishing now costs 3. Greater Portent now costs 4, or 3 when upgraded.
[*]Haruspex now remains active until its queued Foretell resolves and correctly returns Haruspex to hand.
[*]Clairvoyance now uses a stable exact-card selector across hand, draw, discard, and Exhaust piles, fixing missing, duplicated, and unclickable choices.
[*]Revelation threshold reductions now apply specifically to cards with Revelation effects.
[*]Custom attacks that benefit from Vigor now consume it correctly.
[/list]

[b]Fixes and quality of life[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed repeated divination records after saving and loading.
[*]Fixed Star Needle damage scaling and several damage-value versus hit-count errors.
[*]Fixed end-turn stalls and restored a stable static Diviner portrait at rest sites without replacing base rest-site behavior.
[*]Improved Destiny and relic-removal UI layering so game tooltips render above mod overlays.
[*]Corrected energy icons, upgraded descriptions, duplicated keywords, and multiple English/Simplified Chinese localization mismatches.
[*]Expanded validation for paired localization, keyword duplication, mechanics text, and runtime hooks.
[/list]

[h2]简体中文 - 机制与稳定性更新[/h2]
[list]
[*]调整命运为 0 时的规则：此后若将失去命运，则改为减少 1 层命运倒计时。
[*]重做“命运定点”：现在是 1 费技能。本回合命运无法改变，并保留本回合的手牌；升级后为 0 费。
[*]应用最新卡牌平衡调整，涉及“揭示”“诅咒预言”“断线+”“厄运书写+”“险中求生”“星针”“无可避免”“预读”“疫病征兆”“既定路径”“征兆账簿”“天启”“终局”“完美预测”“超脱征兆”“万千未来”以及“殒灭征兆”等机制。
[*]“遗物驱离”费用提高至 3；“大预兆”费用提高至 4，升级后为 3。
[*]修复“脏卜术”的预言效果：现在会在结算时正确将脏卜术加入手牌。
[*]“千里眼”改用稳定的精确选牌界面，可正确搜索手牌、抽牌堆、弃牌堆与消耗牌堆，修复卡牌缺失、重复和无法点击的问题。
[*]降低启示需求的效果现在仅作用于拥有启示效果的卡牌。
[*]受活力加成的自定义攻击现在会正确消耗活力。
[/list]

[b]错误修复与体验优化[/b]
[list]
[*]修复保存并重新载入后占卜记录重复的问题。
[*]修复星针的伤害成长，以及多处伤害数值被错误当作攻击次数的问题。
[*]修复无法结束回合的问题；休息处改为稳定的静态占卜师立绘，不再替换基础休息处逻辑。
[*]调整命运界面和遗物移除界面的层级，使游戏详情提示显示在模组界面上方。
[*]修正能量图标、升级描述、重复关键词，以及多处英文和简体中文文本不一致。
[*]扩展自动检查，覆盖双语文本配对、关键词重复、机制描述与运行时钩子。
[/list]
